An alternative to instant ship transfer?
***TLDR:*** Create an in-game market for FSD boost materials (and maybe other materials while we're at it) with really high-prices.  CMDRs can then buy low, medium, and high-grade jumponium to move their ships around.

***Post:*** The way I see instant ship transfer mostly being used is to transfer low-jump range combat ships across the bubble.  Players will use high jump range ship to travel across the galaxy and then transfer their combat ship.  The idea here is simple, why not just give the combat ship a way to have a jump range equal to the long-distance ship?  Giving CMDRs access to jumponium uses an existing in-game mechanic and FDev can set the cost of the materials equal to what they were planning to make the instant transfer cost.  (I've also always wondered why we don't have a  materials market in the first place.  If an item is in high enough demand like engineer mats are, then there should be a market for it.)

ATM I don't see a down-side to this, except that if a CMDR is flying in a different ship than the one they want, they still have to go retrieve the other ship before heading to their destination.
